name: Artichoke leaf extract
short: Limited data from three trials, in a review Cochrane later withdrew, suggest only mild, transient and infrequent adverse events with short-term use. No interaction data were found.
text: A systematic review of three randomised trials (262 participants) of artichoke leaf extract in people with high cholesterol found that the limited data on safety suggest only mild, transient and infrequent adverse events with short-term use. Cochrane withdrew this review in 2016; the withdrawal notice says the editors consider it a low-priority title. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
